name: CopyItemInput
description: Represents the input for copying an item.

inputFields.name: database
inputFields.description: The name of the item database.

inputFields.name: deepCopy
inputFields.description: Indicates whether to copy all descendent items. The default value is true.

inputFields.name: itemId
inputFields.description: The ID of the item. If both ID and path parameters are specified, the path parameter is ignored.

inputFields.name: targetParentId
inputFields.description: The ID of the parent item. If both ID and path parameters are specified, the target parent path parameter is ignored.

inputFields.name: targetParentPath
inputFields.description: The path of the parent item.
